fields.why: IMBD rates are measured and compared across 3 maternal race/ethnicity groups and 3 maternal age groups.
Maternal age and race/ethnicity are SPDs with 3 groups each; infant sex is a pair, and gestational age and age at death are clinical.

Race: the ranking is backed by ratios of Black and Hispanic vs White rates (Discussion), so per-group vs referent outranks side by side. Age: trends are contrasted across 3 age groups with no interaction test; the Cochran-Armitage tests run across years within each age level (rule 6), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
